links.outcome: Staging accuracy of LLMs versus physicians on the same FDG-PET images
links.effect: LLM accuracy 34% to 78% versus physicians 60% to 85%; physicians significantly higher (P<.05) for thoracic LN, abdominal LN, and cN stages; LLM kappa -0.07 to 0.25.
links.quote: The average accuracy was 41/120 (34%) to 94/120 (78%) for LLMs and 72/120 (60%) to 102/120 (85%) for physicians, with significantly higher accuracy for physicians (P<.05) in the thoracic LN, abdominal LN, and cN stages.

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates the diagnostic accuracy of several multimodal foundation models (e.g., GPT-5, GPT-4 variants) against human clinicians for staging esophageal cancer using PET images, but it does not evaluate any implementation safeguard or deployment practice.
